sam-finance: Quick flag : Got renewal invoice for Acme Labs (INV-ACME-2026-07). Platform annual charged but contract shows platform was prepaid on Jan invoice. Customer refused payment.

nina-accounting: Pulling invoice now. I see line: "Private Platform (annual) $95,000" and "Support Tier 3 monthly $12,500". Did we accidentally reissue platform after a prepaid settlement?

cory-sales: We definitely marked platform as prepaid in the SOW. PO 11021 covers platform for 2026. Sales confirmed receipt in Jan.

billing-bot: Billing engine ran 2026-07-01T03:01:12Z. Applied items: platform_annual price=95000 quantity=1 prorate_flag=false contract_meta.platform_prepaid=false

sam-finance: Looks like contract metadata wasn't set to platform_prepaid=true during ingestion. Can we do a quick remediation so Acme gets a corrected invoice ASAP? AP is holding funds.

maya-cs: Acme's AR contact is luke@acmelabs.com; he's already emailed support. I'll reach out with ETA. They asked for an itemized correction and credit memo.

nina-accounting: We can issue credit memo for $95k and reissue invoice with only support $12,500. Prefer credit memo so payment records stay tied to original invoice. Need sales sign-off and legal ok for audit notes.

eric-legal: Credit memo + corrected invoice sounds fine. Include reference to original invoice INV-ACME-2026-01 and attach SOW snapshot. Add comment 'platform prepaid per PO 11021'.

cory-sales: I approve. I'll upload the signed PO and SOW to this thread now.

billing-bot: Action queued: create_credit_memo CM-ACME-07-1 amount=95000 apply_to=INV-ACME-2026-07 create_invoice INV-ACME-2026-07-R1 amount=12500 note='platform prepaid; corrected as per PO 11021' ETA 90m

sam-finance: Approved. Nina, add billing remark: 'manual true-up; sales approved; attach PO 11021' and set payment terms Net-30 per customer request.

nina-accounting: Will do. I'll upload CM and corrected invoice to Stripe and email Luke with documents. Marking invoice status adjusted.

maya-cs: I'll notify Luke once it's sent and confirm they will release payment for the support line.

sam-finance: Follow-up: create a billing-config ticket to validate platform_prepaid flag on contract ingestion to prevent recurrence. Assign to @billing-engine team.

cory-sales: Created ticket billing/ingest#512 and assigned to kevin-ops.

billing-bot: Logged actions and ticket reference billing/ingest#512.
